title: CAUSALLY FAIR GENERATION WITH LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring causal effects (direct, indirect, and spurious) and total variation in LLM-generated profiles (e.g., income, health outcomes, marijuana use) across racial groups (Black/Hispanic vs. White) using a cross-fitted one-step estimator based on survey data.

Measuring causal effects (direct, indirect, and spurious) and total variation in LLM-generated profiles (e.g., employment status, salary) across sex groups (Female vs. Male) using a cross-fitted one-step estimator based on census data.
